property_summary: For every admissible amount a, calling AdjustDifficulty(a) as owner sets the game difficulty to exactly a, i.e. currentDifficulty() == a afterwards; the mutant stores a + 1, so for a < type(uint256).max the getter returns a + 1 and the rule fails.
change_summary: Replace the assignment so difficulty is set to amount + 1 instead of amount.
